title: Auto-restart a crashed session
acceptance criteria: Session killed at 11:00 (fake process in a test) is restarted within 60 s with open signals reloaded and a Telegram 'restarted' message; after 3 crashes a 'giving up' alert is sent; a container start after 15:00 with open intraday signals runs a manage-only session to 15:31

title: Non-blocking durable alert outbox
acceptance criteria: Engine loop never blocks more than 50 ms on Telegram (slow fake in a test); a message sent during a 5-minute Telegram outage is delivered afterwards; zero duplicate messages (dedupe key per signal and event)

title: Out-of-band recorder watchdog
acceptance criteria: Stopping the recorder container during market hours raises an alert within 3 minutes (API-side heartbeat check or an external uptime monitor on the recorder health endpoint)

title: Warm-up history retry and alert; safer indicator guards
acceptance criteria: Two history jobs failing with a fake AB1021 are retried and recovered; a permanent failure sends a Telegram warning; the morning brief states 'history N/M loaded'; indicator readiness guards are at least 120 bars or flagged low-confidence

title: Persist duplicate-signal keys across restarts
acceptance criteria: Unit test: after a mid-day engine restart the same setup and side does not produce a second signal (keys rebuilt from today's evaluations and signals)

title: Kill switch and pause control
acceptance criteria: Admin toggle stops new signals within one tick while open signals stay managed; an alert and an audit row are written; an 'exit-all advice' action exists; rule edits show 'applies from next session'

title: Secrets hygiene: SECRET_KEY and OpenAI key rotation
acceptance criteria: SECRET_KEY is set on the api and recorder services and the Account card shows the key comes from the environment; the previously exposed OpenAI key is revoked and replaced

title: 2027 NSE holidays and event-calendar upkeep
acceptance criteria: NseCalendar has the 2027 holidays before 31 Dec 2026; 2027 events are entered; a startup alert fires 30 days before the holiday list runs out (tested)

title: Verify Angel OI units for the liquidity filter
acceptance criteria: Angel option OI on the first live day is compared with the NSE option chain; the unit is documented; MIN_OI depends on the provider and a test covers both providers

title: Auto-demote losing setups
acceptance criteria: After each close the rolling 30-signal expectancy per setup is computed; a synthetic losing streak removes the setup from LIVE and sends an alert naming it

title: Research history in Postgres; fix Entry and Exchange columns; Export
acceptance criteria: Research runs and usage survive a redeploy; Entry shows the real entry; Exchange shows BSE for .BO tickers; Export downloads a CSV (or the button is removed); rows no longer look clickable without an action

title: News pillar from RSS feeds
acceptance criteria: RBI, PIB and NSE announcement feeds are read with publish times; a known RBI notice blocks entries for its window; the board shows the headline; no free text reaches an LLM in the trading loop

title: Branded 404/error/loading pages; RouteGuard waits for the role
acceptance criteria: Unknown URL shows a branded 404 with links back; render errors show a branded error page; a viewer opening an admin URL sees no 403 in the console and no flash of admin content

title: Harden the research API
acceptance criteria: Invalid ticker returns 422 (regex ^[A-Z0-9&.-]{1,20}$); a browser disconnect stops further LLM calls; a daily cost cap is enforced; /api/pricehistory no longer blocks other requests under a load test

title: Historical backtest harness with walk-forward
acceptance criteria: One command fetches 2+ years of NIFTY futures 1-minute history within Angel limits, reprices options with Black-76 from labelled IV proxies, runs the live engine code walk-forward (6-month train / 1-month test) with full costs and a benchmark, and reports per setup: trades, expectancy with 95% CI, profit factor, max drawdown and Deflated Sharpe Ratio

title: Track-record statistics and benchmarks
acceptance criteria: Performance page shows per setup: expectancy with 95% CI, t-stat, trades still needed for significance, Sharpe and Sortino on daily P&L, CAGR on the paper account, and NIFTY buy-and-hold and random-entry benchmarks

title: Calibrate confidence score and pillars
acceptance criteria: Win rate and average R reported by score band and per pillar status; a drop-one-pillar ablation is run; weights or pillars are revised with evidence (win rate rises with band, or redundant trend votes are merged)

title: LLM reproducibility and research-agent fixes
acceptance criteria: Every run stores prompt, response, model snapshot and parameters; model is pinned; temperature 0; one retry layer; sentiment uses only supplied headlines (no model memory); headlines are delimited and sanitised; research RSI uses Wilder smoothing; a with/without-debate ablation report exists

title: Market-data quality: outlier filter, retention, ts index, completeness
acceptance criteria: Status endpoint answers in under 50 ms with 10 million bar rows (index on ts or last_bar_at in app_meta); 1-year retention or partitioning; ticks more than 8 sigma from the 1-minute median are rejected and counted; a daily completeness report (target 99.5%) and session_events are visible in the UI

title: Accessibility pass to WCAG 2.2 AA
acceptance criteria: axe-core reports 0 critical and 0 serious violations on all screens at 375 and 1440 px: muted text at least 4.5:1, labelled selects, charts with role=img and a table view, always-underlined inline links, 24 px targets, visible focus wherever outline-none is set, h1 on Signal detail

title: Layout-shift fixes
acceptance criteria: CLS is at most 0.1 on every screen at 375, 768 and 1440 px (History, Research, Signal detail, Agents, Paper) using content-sized skeletons and reserved chart heights

title: CI/CD pipeline with quality gates
acceptance criteria: Every PR runs pytest with coverage at least 85%, tsc, next build with ignoreBuildErrors off, npm audit, pip-audit, the TA-Lib reference check and the repaint test; a PR that drops coverage or breaks types is blocked; deploys go from the main branch only

title: Dependency hygiene: lock files and Next.js upgrade
acceptance criteria: Python and npm lock files are committed; Next.js upgraded to a patched 15.5.x or 16.x line; kiteconnect dropped if Kite stays unused; npm audit and pip-audit show 0 high or critical findings

title: Session and transport security
acceptance criteria: Session token moves to an httpOnly SameSite cookie behind a same-origin proxy (not readable from JS); CSP and security headers are set; CORS allows only the UI origin; the login throttle and API rate limits persist in Postgres across restarts

title: Setups S4 to S7
acceptance criteria: Each new setup passes the evidence bar in shadow (expectancy CI above 0 over the required trades) before LIVE; S6 has a gamma-risk cap; expiry-day behaviour matches the documented plan

title: BANKNIFTY and FINNIFTY monthly positional setups
acceptance criteria: Constituents and monthly-only expiry rules are added; shadow results meet the same evidence bar before LIVE

title: Second alert channel and shock detector
acceptance criteria: During a simulated Telegram outage a fallback channel delivers the message; a synthetic return or VIX z-score shock blocks new entries for 15 minutes

title: Metrics and observability dashboard
acceptance criteria: Ticks per minute, evaluation time and alert latency are recorded as time series with a dashboard; an alert fires when an evaluation takes more than 2 s

title: README and architecture notes
acceptance criteria: A root README covers architecture, local run and deploy; a new developer runs the stack locally in under 30 minutes

title: UI end-to-end and visual regression tests
acceptance criteria: Playwright E2E for sign-in, signals, signal detail, paper, performance and connectors runs on every PR; docs/review/scripts/ui_screens.py runs as a screenshot and axe gate (fail on critical/serious axe or CLS above 0.1)

title: Compliance guardrails for viewer accounts
acceptance criteria: Creating a viewer account requires a 'personal use only, not investment advice' acknowledgement; terms appear in the footer; data-licence limits are documented

title: Broker-side stop-loss guidance on signal cards
acceptance criteria: Telegram card and Signal detail say 'Place an SL order (trigger Rs X, limit just below) or a GTT right after your entry' (NSE doesn't accept SL-M on options); an optional 'SL placed?' reminder exists; a card snapshot test covers the text
